clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 霸王龙化石拍卖：2500万美元的资产泡沫？

subtitles.en: Shen was a T-rex that the auction house Christie's announced in 2022 and it was going to be the first T-rex ever to go on sale in Asia.
subtitles.zh: 2022年，佳士得宣布拍卖一具名为“申”的霸王龙化石，这将是亚洲首只上拍的霸王龙。
en_highlights: first T-rex ever to go on sale in Asia

subtitles.en: This was poised to be a major sale. Shen's auction never went forward. About 10 days before the scheduled auction date Christie's pulled the sale.
subtitles.zh: 这本是一场重磅拍卖，但最终未能成行。距预定拍卖日约10天时，佳士得撤回了拍卖。

subtitles.en: Dinosaur bones have absolutely become an asset class in recent years.
subtitles.zh: 近年来，恐龙骨骼已完全成为一种资产类别。

subtitles.en: This wasn't always the case. About 20 or so years ago dinosaur bones were more of a novelty. Recently they've taken on a whole new kind of cache in the investing world. They've basically become a collectible.
subtitles.zh: 但并非一直如此。大约20年前，恐龙骨骼还只是新奇之物。如今，它们在**界获得了全新的价值，基本成为了一种收藏品。

subtitles.en: Auction houses are interested, collectors are interested, brokers have emerged. But this market of dinosaur fossils really is a wild west of a market.
subtitles.zh: 拍卖行、收藏家、经纪商纷纷涌入。但恐龙化石市场实际上是一片蛮荒之地。

subtitles.en: There's no oversight body. That's really overseeing what's real versus what's not.
subtitles.zh: 没有监管机构来监督真伪。
en_highlights: overseeing what's real versus what's not

subtitles.en: Interestingly, the dinosaur bones you're likely to come in contact with at museums are sometimes partly, sometimes mostly fake.
subtitles.zh: 有趣的是，你在博物馆看到的恐龙骨骼有时部分、甚至大部分是假的。

subtitles.en: On average 30 to 60% of that dinosaur specimen is real meaning real fossilized bones and the rest are made up of cast parts or sculpted replica or some of their kind of what we would call fake bone.
subtitles.zh: 平均而言，30%到60%的恐龙标本是真正的化石骨骼，其余由铸件、雕塑复制品或所谓的假骨组成。

subtitles.en: In a museum, that kind of reconstruction can be expected. But in a multi-million dollar auction, the amount of original fossil bone can affect how a specimen is valued.
subtitles.zh: 在博物馆中，这种重建可以接受。但在数百万美元的拍卖中，原始化石骨骼的数量会影响标本的估值。
en_highlights: affect how a specimen is valued
